import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Get the first project heading link from the list
    first_project_heading = page.get_by_role('heading', name='Umano: News Read To You / AndroidSlidingUpPanel', level=2)
    first_project_link = first_project_heading.get_by_role('link')
    
    # Click the link to navigate to the project page
    await first_project_link.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Find the star button on the project page; it might be named 'Star' or 'Unstar'
    star_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Star')
    
    # If the star button exists and is visible, click it to star the project
    if await star_button.is_visible():
        await star_button.click()
        # Wait for any state change
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Navigate back to the 'Most stars' page
    await page.go_back()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
